changeSet.sql: -- Append-only: blocks UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE. TG_ARGV[0] = constraint name. CREATE FUNCTION zc_forbid_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION '%: % is append-only; % is not permitted', TG_ARGV[0], TG_TABLE_NAME, TG_OP USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation', CONSTRAINT = TG_ARGV[0], TABLE = TG_TABLE_NAME; END $fn$;
